item.tib: 'brug gsas rtsa sgrub kyi bskang bshags rig stong 'od gsal snying po'i rang sgra
item.coloph: ces 'brug gsas rtsa sgrub kyi bskang (skong) bshags rig stong 'od gsal snying po'i rang sgra zhes bya ba 'di yang grwa slob bstan pa lhun grub kyis snga phyi lan grangs bcu lhag tsam du nan cher bskul bar brten/ btsun gzugs snyoms las pa tshul khrims bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du 'bod pas sug bris byas pa'o//
